svg.title: VacSol-ML workflow
svg.desc: VacSol-ML workflow: ESKAPE proteomes are filtered with BLASTp, annotated with physicochemical and biological features, preprocessed, engineered with autoencoders, trained and validated with stratified 5-fold cross-validation, benchmarked and deployed.
svg.text: From ESKAPE proteomes to a deployed model: homology filtering, feature annotation,
autoencoder-based feature engineering and stratified 5-fold cross-validated training.
